purpose: Source discovery and evidence-role review only; no new scene, model, training or expert contact.

sources.citation: Gronostajska, B. E.; Szczegielniak, A. (2021). Inside a Microapartment: Design Solutions to Support Future Sustainable Lifestyles. Buildings 11(12), 654.
sources.license_observed: CC BY 4.0 on PDF page 2 (article p.1).
sources.available_evidence: Named real projects; areas/volumes in Table 2; author-drawn schematic plans with scale bars in Appendix A; conditional functional, spatial, furniture and visual analysis.
sources.boundary: Schemes depict final architecture, not a raw pre-design brief, measured survey or native editable furniture model. Figure-specific external photo credits need separate review.
sources.method_limit: Common design frequency is not a causal measure of resident benefit; resident acceptance is deferred to future work by the authors.
source_inconsistencies: Table 2 lists M.S.1 area 35.3 m2 despite a stated 35 m2 selection ceiling.
The XXS group includes 15.4 and 15.3 m2 despite its stated under-15 m2 band.
sources.admission: High-priority source corpus candidate; deduplicate project families and review provenance before any derivation. Authored analysis may support scoped rationale, not automatically expert-approved action labels.
sources.sealed_test_eligibility: Target descriptions/schemes inspected in this source review; do not use these exposed cases as sealed test.

sources.citation: Bollo, C. (2022). Designed for Home: Opportunities for Enhanced Ontological Security in Permanent Supportive Housing Apartments. Journal of Interior Design 47(4), 49–67.
sources.license_observed: CC Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs on PDF page 1. No assumed permission to publish adapted plans or training corpus.
sources.available_evidence: Archival plan analysis; two academic/professional housing experts reviewed the relevance and construction of the affordance indicators.
sources.independent_evidence_scope: Expert involvement concerns that study's indicators, not our outputs or an independent preference comparison of our rooms.
sources.method_limit: Two-dimensional archival evidence; incomplete resident perspectives and site context. Do not infer measured psychological/health benefit from geometry.
sources.admission: Evaluation-method reference only at this stage; no adapted plan or training labels exported.
sources.sealed_test_eligibility: Source outcomes have been inspected; no sealed evaluation allocation.
